Features

01

### Connection management

`DBConnection_v9` wraps an ODBC or SQLite connection with lazy connect,
explicit disconnect, and automatic reconnect via `$autoconnection`.

02

### Bulk table operations

`DBTable_v9` handles insert, upsert, and key-based row deletion against
PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite tables, with configurable indexes.

03

### Field validation

Pluggable validators check field types and field contents before data
reaches the database, with built-in schemas for the csverse
`csfmt_rts_data` format.

# Package index

## Core Database Classes

Main R6 classes for database connection and table management

- [`DBConnection_v9`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/DBConnection_v9.md)
  : R6 Class representing a database connection
- [`DBTable_v9`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/DBTable_v9.md) :
  R6 Class representing a database table

## Database Utilities

Helper functions for database operations and metadata

- [`get_table_names_and_info()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/get_table_names_and_info.md)
  : Get table names, number of rows, and size information
- [`insert_data_many()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/insert_data_many.md)
  : Insert data into several tables in one transaction
- [`csdb_set_auth_hook()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_set_auth_hook.md)
  : Set authentication hook for database connections
- [`csdb_get_auth_hook()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_get_auth_hook.md)
  : Get the current authentication hook
- [`csdb_set_password_hook()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_set_password_hook.md)
  : Set the password hook for PostgreSQL connections
- [`csdb_get_password_hook()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_get_password_hook.md)
  : Get the current password hook
- [`csdb_set_context()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_set_context.md)
  : Set the caller context
- [`csdb_get_context()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_get_context.md)
  : Get the caller context
- [`csdb_connection_is_alive()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/csdb_connection_is_alive.md)
  : Does a database connection still reach its server?

## Data Validation

Functions for validating field types and data contents

- [`validator_field_types_blank()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/validator_field_types_blank.md)
  : Blank field types validator
- [`validator_field_types_csfmt_rts_data_v1()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/validator_field_types_csfmt_rts_data_v1.md)
  : Field types validator for csfmt_rts_data_v1 schema
- [`validator_field_types_csfmt_rts_data_v2()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/validator_field_types_csfmt_rts_data_v2.md)
  : Field types validator for csfmt_rts_data_v2 schema
- [`validator_field_contents_blank()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/validator_field_contents_blank.md)
  : Blank data contents validator
- [`validator_field_contents_csfmt_rts_data_v1()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/validator_field_contents_csfmt_rts_data_v1.md)
  : Field contents validator for csfmt_rts_data_v1 schema
- [`validator_field_contents_csfmt_rts_data_v2()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/validator_field_contents_csfmt_rts_data_v2.md)
  : Field contents validator for csfmt_rts_data_v2 schema

## Synthetic Data

Profiles, simulation, and the synthetic data contract of one table

- [`profile_query()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/profile_query.md)
  : Profile the result of a SQL query
- [`profile_table()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/profile_table.md)
  : Profile a DBTable_v9
- [`profile_data()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/profile_data.md)
  : Profile a data frame
- [`profile_schema()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/profile_schema.md)
  : A profile that holds only a schema
- [`write_profile()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/write_profile.md)
  : Write a profile to a YAML file
- [`read_profile()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/read_profile.md)
  : Read a profile from a YAML file
- [`simulate_from_profile()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/simulate_from_profile.md)
  : Simulate a table from a profile
- [`profile_compare()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/profile_compare.md)
  : Compare two profiles
- [`SyntheticTable`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/SyntheticTable.md)
  : The synthetic data contract of one table
- [`synthetic_table_from_dir()`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/synthetic_table_from_dir.md)
  : Build a SyntheticTable from a directory

## Datasets

Example datasets included with the package

- [`nor_covid19_cases_by_time_location`](https://niphr.github.io/csdb/reference/nor_covid19_cases_by_time_location.md)
  : Covid-19 data for PCR-confirmed cases in Norway (nation and county)
